findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public with no ACL set to private and no public access block configuration, allowing unauthorized read/write access to potentially sensitive customer data stored in it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest.
